defs.def: a book with spaces for each day of the year in which you can write down things you have to do in the future （工作日程）记事簿

ex.s: Simply keeping a diary that keeps track of friends’ birthdays and other important dates will make sure nothing slips by you.

defs.def: a book in which you can write down the experiences you have each day, your private thoughts, etc. 日记；日记簿

ex.s: The Princess Diaries Viewer reviews What an interesting movie 2 March | by Jane The princess Diaries is a movie about a teenager named Mia Thermopolis.
ex.t: 《公主日记》 观众评论 多有趣的电影 3月2日 | by Jane 《公主日记》是一部关于一个名叫Mia Thermopolis的少女的电影。

ex.s: The Princess Diaries is an interesting movie.
ex.t: 《公主日记》是一部有趣的电影。

ex.s: You'll need to report back via weekly blogs, photo diaries and video updates.
ex.t: 你需要通过每周博客、照片日记和视频更新来汇报。

ex.s: The Diary of a Young Girl WEDNESDAY, 3 MAY 1944 Dearest Kitty, For the last two weeks we’ve been eating lunch at eleven-thirty on Saturdays; in the mornings we have to make do with a cup of cereal.
ex.t: 《安妮日记》 1944年5月3日 星期三 最亲爱的Kitty，最近两个星期我们周六十一点半吃午饭；早上我们只能喝一杯麦片粥凑合。

ex.s: I look upon our life in hiding as an interesting adventure, full of danger and romance, and every privation as an amusing addition to my diary.
ex.t: 我视我们躲藏中的生活为一段有趣的冒险，充满危险和浪漫，而每一种匮乏都看作是我日记里有趣的一笔。
